summary: This short housekeeping document declares RFC 4693 historic and obsoletes it. It was published for information, not as a standards-track specification, so that readers stop treating the older document as current guidance.

eli5.summary: Imagine a library putting an old, out-of-date book in a case marked "for history only" so nobody uses it by mistake. This note does that for one old RFC.

questions: how to move an rfc to historic
subtitle: A short housekeeping memo that retires RFC 4693, the IETF Operational Notes experiment, to Historic.

tldr.problem: RFC 4693 created the IETF Operational Notes (IONs) series as an experiment, and the IESG later ended that experiment, leaving the RFC looking current.
tldr.mechanism: This document moves RFC 4693 to Historic status and obsoletes it, to reflect that the experiment was closed.
tldr.outcome: Readers can see that the IONs series is no longer an active process. The RFC points to the IESG for details on why it ended.

today: RFC 6393 obsoletes RFC 4693 and moves it to Historic. It has not been obsoleted itself.

sections.title: Purpose of the Document
sections.content: This document moves RFC 4693 to Historic status and obsoletes it. It is administrative only and has no security issues, according to the text.
sections.eli5: This note has one job: to label one old paper as history.

sections.title: What RFC 4693 Set Up
sections.content: RFC 4693 established the IETF Operational Notes (IONs) series on an experimental basis, following RFC 3933. The series was meant to discuss the set of procedures that the IETF follows but for which the RFC publication process is an inappropriate documentation vehicle.
sections.eli5: It was a trial notebook for how the club does things, for the kind of notes that did not belong in the main library.

sections.title: Closing the Experiment
sections.content:
Under RFC 3933, the IESG decided in March 2008 to terminate the IONs process experiment. This document moves RFC 4693 to Historic status, following the IESG statement on designating RFCs as Historic, to reflect that the experiment is closed.

The RFC does not give the reasons for the termination. It asks readers to contact the IESG at the address it lists for details, including the motivation and the further destiny of IONs.
sections.eli5: The club decided to stop the trial notebook in 2008. This note just makes that official on the paper itself.

references.text: Alvestrand, H., "IETF Operational Notes", RFC 4693, October 2006.
Klensin, J. and S. Dawkins, "A Model for IETF Process Experiments", BCP 93, RFC 3933, November 2004.
